text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is here. Эйсин Флэш looks

perfectly calm and collected.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let's review the top competitors
appearing in this
race.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
First, Фудзи Кисэки. While this distance may
not be
her strong suit, she will no doubt
be a difficult
opponent in this race.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Next, Манхэттен Кафе. She spoke of
feeling fated
to win the upcoming Spring
Shield and is thus
ablaze with
determination to win today.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
They're my most formidable foes. Not
only do
they have an affinity with the
course, they also
have impressive track
records.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Today's race could become quite
ferocious.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You seem to be excited for it, though.

text_block_list.text:
I must admit, my heart is pulsing with

anticipation.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It's strange. Two months ago, all I felt
for this
moment was fear.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: That proves you're more ready now.

text_block_list.text:
After all, I have been training the
correct way all
this time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Now I've just got to hold my head high
and keep
running toward my goal!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
